name: VRSBench
description: VRSBench is a versatile vision-language benchmark dataset for remote sensing image understanding, containing 29,614 images with detailed captions, object references, and 123,221 question-answer pairs. It supports multiple tasks including image captioning, visual grounding, and visual question answering.
reputation: A recent remote-sensing vision-language benchmark that is gaining attention for covering captioning, grounding, and VQA in one dataset.
notes: Focuses on general-purpose vision-language tasks in remote sensing with human-verified captions and object references.
